notes: Setup: the sandbox had Node v22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24+; installed Node v24.22.3 from nodejs.org (sha256 checked) in the scratchpad (~10s). Bootstrap npm,submodule,reference with --allow-unpinned-reference took 221s (npm 9s, submodule 8s, reference build 204s). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+video-operator-registry test before changes: 67s, green (8 tests).
The differential file runs in about 18s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs; the unit file in under 1s.

cas_slice8 calls no lrintf: the weighted mean is passed to av_clip_uint8(int), so C truncates it toward zero. The spec note about lrintf half-even rounding does not apply to this kernel; truncation is what matches native (a unit case pins 25.70 -> 25, and a Math.round mutation fails 3 differential tests).

Mutations that drop the Math.fround of weight, of the denominator 1+4*weight, or of the lerpf strength each fail 2 differential tests (the linux-gated API and CLI tests). Reordering the clip for the all-zero NaN case is not observable: the output there is 0 either way.
The linux-x64 gate is a precaution: no macOS run was possible here, so no macOS difference was measured. The planes=0 copy cases, refusals and copy negotiation run on every platform.
AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAGS values are not range-checked by write_number, so planes above 15 are accepted as natively (planes=0xff is tested).
The native list (58 formats) is returned by formats() in declared order; registry examples run from gray, which is in the list, and one starts with format=yuv420p.
